entries.name: Headseeker
entries.desc:

The perk actually multiplies the Precision Bonus by 1.2x, but the actual Precision Damage Increase results are easier to explain.

Adaptive Pulse = 7.1% | Aggressive Pulse = 10% | Heavy Burst Pulse = 9.5%
High-Impact Pulse = 8.74% | Lightweight Pulse = 6.3% | Rapid-Fire Pulse = 10.3%
Adaptive Burst Sidearm = 8.46% | Heavy Burst Sidearm = 7.36%
Precision Scout Rifle = 8.66%
Heavy Burst Hand Cannon = 7% increased Weakspot Damage.

↑Passively grants +5 Stability.

What even is a Weakspot? How is it different from a Precision Hit?
Weakspot Hits that do not register as a Precision Hit can still benefit or trigger Weakspot effects, such as Headseeker, or Heavy Burst Hand Cannon's intrinsic 9.5% Weakspot Damage Buff.
Similarly, Precision Hits are not always scored on Weakspots, and may not trigger Weakspot effects.
One such example are Shielded Combatants. Weakspot Damage Increases will work when other Precision Hit Increases wouldn't.

Generate = Grants Ammo to Magazine out of thin air, up to its Base Magazine Size. Does not work with Overflown Magazines.

entries.name: Amplified
entries.desc:
Intrinsic Arc Subclass Buff
Obtained by reaching 100% Counter Progress through Arc Kills within 6 seconds of each, or through Aspects.
Rank-And-File = 25% | Elite = 50% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 50%

Amplified:
+50 Mobility, increases Slide Distance to 8.5 meters, +40 Handling, and 0.95x Handling Duration Multiplier for 15 seconds.
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer and grants 15% Damage Resist against Combatants while active.
While Amplified, sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.

Speed Booster:
Maximizes Movement Speed, increased Slide Distance to 11 meters, 25% Increased Jump Height, and 15% Damage Resist against Combatants.
Speed Booster lingers for 2 seconds until no longer sprinting, even after Amplified runs out.
Performing a Speed Booster Slide permanently increases base Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters until death.

entries.name: Bolt Charge
entries.desc:
Upon scoring a Magazine-Based amount of Weapon Damage Instances within 5 seconds of each while Bolt Charge is active:
The next damage instance from any source will grant a stack of Bolt Charge.
Swapping weapons resets the counter. Can only gain up to 1 stack per simultaneous damage instance.

Damage instances needed to gain a stack:
(15% of Magazine, rounded down) + 1
Swords and GLs: 2
3-Ammo Snipers: 1

Gaining a Bolt Charge stack grants 2.5% Melee Ability Energy per Bolt Charge stack obtained, generally granting 25% Melee Ability Energy over the 10 stacks needed to discharge.
Acquiring over x10 stacks through abilities will still grant the corresponding Ability Gains (For example, being at x9 and acquiring x4 will still grant 10% Melee Energy)

After 0.5 seconds of scoring an Ability Hit or dealing Unpowered Melee Damage while at x10 Bolt Charge stacks:
Discharges an Arc Bolt over the damaged enemy, dealing up to 405 Bolt Splash + 270 Ground Splash = 675 Total [36 Bolt Splash + 30 Ground Splash] Arc Damage over ? meters.
Does not count as Ability Damage, only as Generic Arc Damage.

Triggers Discharge:
Volatile Explosions | Freeze Shatter (Not auto-shatter on Bosses) | Tangle Explosions | Threadlings | Unraveling Threads | Suspend Snap on Bosses | Forerunner's The Rock

Do NOT trigger Discharge:
 Jolt's Chain Lightning | Scorch and Ignitions (from Non-Abilities) | Crystal Shatter (from Non-Abilities) | Gifted Conviction's Explosives

entries.name: Blind
entries.desc:

entries.name: Jolted
entries.desc:
Jolted Enemies will release chain lightning for 10 [5] seconds, dealing 119 [51] Arc Damage to all enemies within 12 meters upon taking 115 [45] damage.
Duration can be refreshed by reinflicting Jolt.
 The damage from the hit that applies Jolt counts towards the damage threshold. Jolt has a 0.8 second cooldown between chain lightning activations.

Guardians that release Chain Lightning do not receive chain damage unless it deals damage to other Guardians.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon receiving Jolt damage.

entries.name: Amplitude
entries.desc:
While Amplified:
Scoring 2 kills within 4 seconds of each creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
Triggering Amplified through an Arc Kill will count the kill towards the 2-kill counter.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon creating an Orb of Power. Kills during the cooldown do not count.

entries.name: Arcbolt Grenade
entries.desc:
Heavy Trajectory | Scan

Scans and targets the closest enemy in Line of Sight within 12 meters upon impact, releasing Arc Lightning towards them after 1 second.
After dealing damage, it chains to the closest enemy within 10 meters that hasn't been hit by Arc Lightning, repeating until it has damaged a maximum of 4 enemies.

Arc Lightning deals 521 [85] damage.

entries.name: Flashbang Grenade
entries.desc:
Medium Trajectory

Explodes after its speed is sufficiently reduced. Has a brief delay before it can explode.

Explosion deals up to 684 [120] damage, down to 0% damage over a 7.5 meter radius, and inflicts blind to enemies within 10 meters for up to 5 [3] seconds.
The user is immune to self-blind.

▸ With Touch of Thunder:
Explodes an additional time on impact, dealing up to 684 [?] damage over 7.5 meters and inflicting blind to enemies within 5 meters.

entries.name: Flux Grenade
entries.desc:
Almost Straight Trajectory | Slight Projectile Tracking | Sticky

Attaches to enemies or surfaces, exploding after 1.7 seconds.

Explosion deals up to 901 [150] damage, down to 0% damage over a 6 meter radius on detonation.
Sticking an enemy increases explosion damage by 66.7% to 1,500 [250] damage.

entries.name: Lightning Grenade
entries.desc:
Medium Trajectory | Wall-Mounted

Attaches to surfaces and enemies, projecting a laser for 1 second before triggering.

Emits a Lightning Bolt every 1.67 seconds, up to a maximum of 4+1 times.
Lightning Bolts deal 373 [120] damage, up to a total of 1492 [1865] [480 [600]] damage.

▸ With Touch of Thunder:
Grants an additional Grenade Ability Charge.
Lightning Bolts after the first inflict Jolt on hit.
Grants x5 Bolt Charge upon dealing damage, up to once per lightning bolt.

entries.name: Pulse Grenade
entries.desc:
Medium Trajectory

Detonates on impact, dealing up to 156 [50] damage in a 6 meter radius.

Periodically pulses every 0.7 seconds, dealing up to 249 [80] damage in a 6 meter radius an additional 5+2 times.
Can deal up to a total of 1,245 [1,743] [530 [690]] damage.

▸ With Touch of Thunder:
Pulse Grenade hits spawn an Ionic Trace and deal increased damage. Incurs a 1 second cooldown between Ionic Trace spawns.

Pulse Damage Increases: 1st = 2% | 2nd = 9% | 3rd = 18.5% | 4th = 24% | 5th onwards = 25%

entries.name: Skip Grenade
entries.desc:
Medium Trajectory | Seekers

Splits on impact, releasing 4 seekers that chase after enemies.

Seekers begin chasing enemies that come within 6 metres of them, exploding after dealing damage, or self-destructing after ~2 seconds if their velocity is low.

entries.name: Solar Effect
entries.desc:
Solar Effect (Scorch | Ignition) damage can be increased through Perks and Exotics, but the source used for initially scorching will determine what it will be counted as.

Inflicting a Solar Effect with a Weapon, such as with Incandescent/Burning Ambition or through Exotic Weapons such as Tommy's Matchbook or Conditional Finality, will result in Solar Effects counting as Weapon Damage, benefitting from Weapon Buffs and Activity Modifiers that exclusively benefit Weapons, such as other Damage Perks, Weapon Stat, Radiant, and Solar Weapon Surges.
New Gear Bonus is applied permanently to all Weapons, so all Solar Effect Damage against Combatants will always be 5% higher than expected, on top of Combatant Rank Scalars.

Inflicting Solar Effects through abilities such as Fusion Grenades and Well of Radiance will result in the Solar Effects counting as Solar Ability Damage, with their damage only being increased by Grenade (Verity's Brow), and Super (Heart of the Flame) Damage Increases respectively. Melee Damage Buffs and 100+ Melee Stat do not increase Solar Effect Damage.
Effects that increase all Ability Damage will benefit all Solar Effects that are initially applied through Solar Abilities.

Activity Modifiers that increase all Solar Damage, such as Solar Surge, will also apply to Solar Effects, regardless of source.

Certain sources of Scorch do not follow the 50% increase, such as Caliban's Hand (x60+0), Tommy's Matchbook (x15+5), Skyburner's Oath (x5+5), among others.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries.desc:
Cloaks the user, granting various benefits, while lowering Maximum Radar Range to 24 meters for 5+2 seconds. Immediately ends upon performing an Offensive Action.
 Radar Booster Weapon Mod removes the Radar Reduction. Reapplying Invisibility without it breaking refreshes the duration of the longest lasting invisibility.

Combatants are unable to directly target the user, preferring to either shoot at the user's last visible location, or not firing. Combatants will track through Loud Actions, but not fire.

Guardians are unable to see the user's health bar, and the user's radar will only ping every 5 seconds for 0.6 seconds, or upon performing Loud Actions.

Weapons and Abilities that are able to home in (Tracking Projectiles) or scan (Firebolt Grenades) for enemies will not target the user, and will stop tracking if they already were.

Offensive Actions: Instantly ends Invisibility
Shooting | Grenade, Melee, Super, or Blink Ability Usage | Barricade or Rift Placement | Vehicle Summon

Overrides Grenade Ability Cooldown to 152 seconds at base while equipped.

Void Shield:
Grants 95?% [64%] Damage Resist against blocked damage, and taunts Combatants in front of the user. Combatants that come into contact with the shield become disoriented.
Generates 10 Void Overshield HP/s that lasts 5+2.5 seconds while draining 7.5% Grenade Energy/s.
Blocking damage decreases Forward Movement Speed by 50?% for 0.5? seconds.
Blocking damage grants Grenade Energy. Energy gains are progressively reduced (over time) OR (as Unbreakable gains damage)?, down to ?% Energy after ? seconds.
Void Shield has no Movement Speed Penalties, only restricting mantling. Sprinting cancels Void Shield.

Releasing [Grenade] or running out of Grenade Energy releases a frontal blast, consuming 50% Grenade Energy and dealing damage up to 11 meters away.
Deals a minimum of 430 [64?] Grenade Damage for not blocking any damage, scaling to 1584 [178?] damage after receiving a lot [?] blocked damage.

Unbreakable Kills grant Devour for 10+5 seconds.

holding grenade
blocking damage in Sentinel Shield (4.5s ICD)
releasing grenade

2.5% super orb
430-1584 damage (scales with blocked damage) frontal blast that gives Devour for 10-15s

entries.name: Diamond Lance
entries.desc:
Creates a Stasis Lance upon scoring 1 [3] Stasis Weapon Kills, an Ability Kill, or a Shatter Kill.
Knockout-Infused Unpowered Melee Guardian Kills will not create a Stasis Lance.

Stasis Lance is a single-use weapon that can be picked up while it is within 3 meters and can held for up to 10 seconds.
Remains for up to 25 seconds on the ground.

[Fire] throws the Stasis Lance, freezing enemies within 5 metres of the impact, shattering crystals on direct impact, and dealing 150 [45] damage.
[Melee] slams the Stasis Lance, freezing enemies within 8 [6.75?] metres, dealing up to 200 [90] damage, and bestowing the user and their allies within ? meters x2 Frost Armor.
Diamond Lances instantly shatter Stasis Crystals upon damaging them.
Diamond Lance Damage is considered Generic Stasis Ability Damage. Not Grenade nor Melee Damage.

Incurs a 7 [17] second cooldown after spawning a Stasis Lance before another can be spawned.

eg.trigger: stasis weapon/ability or shatter kill (7s ICD)
eg.effect: Diamond Lance relic that lasts 25s on ground, can be picked up and either thrown for 136 damage (freezes within 5m of impact) or slammed for 180 damage (freezes within 8m and gives allies within ?m x2 Frost Armor), instantly shattering nearby crystals
eg.analysis: can be useful for chaining frozen enemy kills for melee targeting

entries.name: Drengr's Lash
entries.desc:
On Barricade Placement:
Unleashes a Strand Lash forward that travels up to 30 metres away.
Strand Lash tracks enemies in its path, dealing 60 [30] damage and suspending on hit.

On Thruster Class Ability Usage:
Creates a Strand Knot that explodes after ? seconds, dealing up to 60 [30] damage and suspending in a ? meter radius.

eg.effect:
?% class
30m tracking 61 damage suspending strand lash
eg.analysis: pretty mediocre effect given barricade uptime frequency, even with exotic support

entries.name: Freezing Singularity
entries.desc:
Prismatic Grenade

Deals up to 70 [26] Void Damage on impact, pulling enemies within 12 meters towards it, and creating a miniature black hole orbited by a halo of slowing ice.

The slowing field deals 18 [4] Stasis Damage and inflicts x13? Slow every 0.25 seconds for 3.65 seconds to enemies within 6 meters.

After 5 seconds of impacting, the black hole implodes, infliction suppression and dealing up to 570 [150] Void Damage to enemies within 7 meters.

entries.name: Lightning Surge
entries.desc:
While Sliding:
[Melee Ability] warps the user forward 10 meters, calling down 5 lightning bolts in a ⬠-shape 7 meters away from the exit point, and granting x1 Bolt Charge per enemy hit.
Grants Amplified and x1 Bolt Charge on usage. Does not grant any Bolt Charge past x1 unless hits are scored.
Grants ?% Damage Resist against Combatants for ? seconds after usage. Unable to use during slide if user shoots.

Lightning bolts deal 634 + 127 = 761 [105 + 47 = 152] damage simultaneously and inflict Jolt.

eg.effect: 10m warping slide 761 damage array of 5 bolts around user that give x1 Bolt Charge per enemy hit and Amplified on use, ?% DR for ?s after usage
eg.analysis: only good on prismatic due to triple melee but spammable splash add clear with built-in DR

entries.name: Hellion
entries.desc:
On Class Ability Usage:
Grants Hellion for 20 seconds.

Hellion:
Lobs scorching Solar projectiles every 1.35 seconds towards enemies up to 40 meters away.
Solar projectiles deal up to 217 [38] Solar Grenade Ability Damage and inflict x30 Scorch per hit in a 4 meter radius.
Can trigger Grenade Ability interactions. Hellion-inflicted Solar Effects are not scaled by Grenade Damage.

eg.effect: 30-40 scorch 217 damage 32m 20s turret
eg.analysis: small damage chip and Singeing uptime, roam damage pretty mediocre

entries.name: Feed the Void
entries.desc:
Grants Enhanced Devour upon scoring an Ability Kill, Frozen Enemy Shatter Kill, Volatile Explosion Kill, or a Tangle Kill.
Devour becomes Enhanced Devour.

Enhanced Devour:
Restores 140 HP on activation and grants Enhanced Devour for 10 seconds. Reactivating Enhanced Devour restores 140 HP and refreshes 5 seconds.
Scoring a kill while Enhanced Devour is active restores 140 HP, grants doubled Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5 seconds of its duration.

Grenade Ability Energy on Kill:
Tier 1 Combatant = 15% | T2 = 23.2% | T3 = 27.5% | T4 = 40% | Guardians = 40%

eg.effect:
Devour for 10-15s
Devour gives 140 HP on kill, gives 5-8s extensions, and 15-40% grenade (rank-based, doubled vs. normal)
eg.analysis: enhanced Devour still insane for survivability, great grenade returns too

entries.name: Bleak Watcher
entries.desc:
Hold [Grenade] to convert the Grenade Ability into a Stasis Turret.
Overrides Grenade Cooldown to 159.6 seconds. Ability Chunk Scalars inherit the currently equipped Grenade Ability's Multiplier.

Stasis Turret:
Automatically shoots a burst of 5 seeking projectiles over 0.7 seconds every 2 seconds at enemies within 35 metres, inflicting x20 [x10] Slow for 4.5 [2] seconds per hit.
Lasts for 25 seconds, has 150 Construct HP, and 67% Damage Resist until it has fired.
Bleak Watcher damage counts as Stasis Grenade Ability Damage.

eg.effect: 35m 25-30s 5 seeker x20 Slow for 4.5-9s turret, cooldown overridden to glacier
eg.analysis: great for locking down an area while doing mechanics, duration is an outlier

entries.name: Weaver's Call
entries.desc:
Threadling damage instances grant 10% Class Ability Energy.

Dealing an accumulated total of 700 [?] damage grants a Perched Threadling.
Incurs a 2 second cooldown before additional threadlings can be generated. Cannot generate more than 1 Threadling at a time.
Damage requirement is based on the displayed damage numbers, and is penalized by Power Level Delta.

On Class Ability Usage:
Creates 3 Threadlings, and deploys all Perched Threadlings.

Kills progress a counter that grants a Perched Threadling upon reaching 100%.
 Miniboss and below = 34% | Boss = 100% | Guardians = 67%

threadling hit
700 damage dealt (2s ICD) or 3 miniboss-/1 boss kill
class usage
eg.effect:
10% class
perched threadling
3 threadlings and deploys all perched threadlings
eg.analysis: free damage and class ability cycling, not amazing but easy to obtain value

entries.name: Spirit of the Assassin
entries.desc:
On Powered Melee Kill:
Grants Void Invisibility for 7 seconds.

On Finisher:
Grants Void Invisibility for 10 seconds

entries.name: Spirit of the Star-Eater
entries.desc:
Picking up an Orb of Power while Super is charged grants a stack of Feast of Light, up to a maximum of x6 stacks.
Swapping to another Exotic Class Item with Star-Eaters will maintain the current Feast of Light stacks.

On Super Cast:
Consumes all Feast of Light stacks, increasing Super Damage for 14 seconds.
18.2% | 36.4% | 54.6% | 59.7% | 64.8% | 70% increased Super Damage.

Reduced effectiveness with certain Super Abilities.
Song of Flame does not receive increased Solar Effect Damage.
Nova Bomb, Thundercrash, and Twilight Arsenal receive up to 50% Increased Super Damage.
Needlestorm receives up to 35% Increased Super Damage.

entries.name: Spirit of the Inmost Light
entries.desc:
On Grenade or Class Ability Usage, or upon dealing Powered Melee Damage:
Grants a stack of Empowered Abilities for the other two abilities for 5 seconds, up to 2 stacks.
e.g.: Dealing Combination Blow damage -> Increased Grenade and Class Ability Regeneration.

Empowered Abilities:
x1 = 400% [100%] | x2 = 800% [200%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate.
x1 = 25% | x2 = 50% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.

Buff display is NOT accurate to the active ability regen.
With the example in mind, Class Ability Usage before Empowered x1 from Melee runs out will do the following:
Grenade Empower will go to x2 and will have its duration refreshed. Melee will receive Empower x1 for 5 seconds, and Class Empower x1 won't be refreshed, despite the UI saying Empowered x2

entries.name: Spirit of the Synthoceps
entries.desc:
While within 15 metres of 3 enemies:
Grants Biotic Enhancements for 5 seconds.

Biotic Enhancements:
165% [100%] Increased Melee Damage.
100% Increased Glaive Melee Damage.

Decreased effectiveness with Lightning Surge against Guardians.

entries.name: Spirit of the Ophidian
entries.desc: Passively grants +35 Handling.

entries.name: Spirit of Verity
entries.desc:
Upon scoring a Grenade-Element Matching Weapon Kill:
Grants a stack of Death Throes, up to 5 stacks, increasing Grenade Ability Damage and granting Bonus Grenade Ability Energy per second per stack.
Loses 1 Death Throes stack upon expiring, rather than all of them.

Death Throes:
x1 = 40% [20%] increased Grenade Damage, +0.5% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 8 seconds.
x2 = 55% [40%] increased Grenade Damage, +1% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 7 seconds.
x3 = 70% [60%] increased Grenade Damage, +1.5% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 6 seconds.
x4 = 85% [80%] increased Grenade Damage, +2% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 5 seconds.
x5 = 100% increased Grenade Damage, +2.5% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 4 seconds.

Cross Counter's Melee Attack deals Arc Damage.

entries.desc:

entries.desc:

Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite+ and Guardians = 50%
Grants a stack of Burning Souls for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.

x1 = x3 Cure.

 x3 = x2 Cure + Restoration x1 for 5 seconds.
If Restoration is active, then it will extend its duration by the corresponding duration.

Overrides Barricade Cooldown with Towering Barricade's?.

Spawns 2 Stasis Crystals.

Instantly restores Health and Shields to the wielder and allies in Line of Sight within 12 metres.

entries.desc:

Enemy triggers a Kinetic Explosion, dealing up to 400 [?] damage over ? meters

15% Increased Movement Speed.

66% Fixed Bonus Grenade and Melee Ability Energy per second for 8 seconds.

Coldsnap Grenades have better tracking, and travel 17.5% further and faster.

Storm, Healing, Threadling, and Vortex Grenade Ability Energy:
T1 Combatant = 3% | T2 = 5.7% | T3 = 8.4% | T4 & Healing = 12% | Guardian = 5%

While Radiant, in a Well of Radiance or Empowering Rift:
Grants 5% Fixed Grenade Energy per Weapon Hit.

Secant Filaments' Devour can be refreshed to 11 seconds.

Kills grant 10% Class Ability Energy.

entries.name: Spirit of the Swarm
entries.desc:
Upon destroying a Tangle:
Spawns 2 Threadlings.

Melee Hits inflict Potent Corruption.
Corrupted enemies spread Potent Corruption on death in a 5 metre radius.

Potent Corrupted Damage ticks every 0.52 [0.7] seconds up to 19 [?] times over 10 [?] seconds, dealing 32 [5?] Kinetic Damage every tick, totalling 640 [?] damage over its duration.

Triggers an Arc Shockwave that deals 360 [100] Arc Damage and staggers in a 7.5 metres radius.
Additional shockwaves occur every 5 seconds, until the Rift expires.

While an Arc Super Ability is equipped, shockwaves blind.

entries.desc:
Hunters intrinsically possess the following traits over Titans and Warlocks:

Base Sprint Speed is 8.5 meters per second, compared to their baseline of 8m/s.
Baseline 100 [70] Mobility and 0.9x [0.95x] Ready/Stow Animation Duration.
Sprint Speed Increase is equivalent to that of an Exotic Armor-based Sprint Boost, only being able to stack with a Lightweight Weapon.

entries.name: Acrobat's Dodge
entries.desc:
Performs an acrobatic leap, that, upon landing, grants the user and their allies within 10 meters Radiant for 10+5 seconds.
Enemies within 6.5 meters are dealt up to 40 [20] Solar Damage upon landing.

entries.name: Gambler's Dodge
entries.desc:
Performs a deft tumble that grants 1% [0.35%] Melee Ability Energy per Melee Stat, up to 100% [35%] Melee Ability Energy at 100 Melee Stat.
Dodging within 15 meters of an enemy doubles the Ability Energy gained. No Chunk or Stat Scalar.
Removes Combatant Projectile Tracking, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians during the Dodge Animation.

entries.desc:
Performs an evasive maneuver that reloads all weapons and picks up Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.
Removes Combatant Projectile Tracking, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians during the Dodge Animation.

entries.desc:
Titans intrinsically possess the following traits over Hunters and Warlocks:

 20% [5%] Increased Basic Melee Damage.
Increased damage is multiplicative.

entries.name: Rally Barricade
entries.desc:
Creates a short, curved barricade construct in front of the caster that blocks all damage dealt to it.
Grants 20% [20%] Damage Resist while in the Barricade Placement animation.

Barricade lasts for 20 seconds, and has 500 Construct HP. Barricades have 90% Damage Resist against Combatants, and ?% against Boss Combatants.
Enemies that pass through the barricade rapidly receive ? [?] non-lethal damage every ? seconds.

While within ? meters behind the Rally Barricade:
80% Damage Resist against Splash Damage from Combatants.
Combatants up to ? meters in front of the barricade are taunted.
+30 Stability, +100 Reload Speed, 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier, 10% Increased Damage Falloff Distance, and 50% Flinch Resist.

entries.name: Thruster
entries.desc:
Performs an evasive first-person dash that removes Combatant Projectile Tracking?, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians.

Quickly dashes 8 metres towards the currently held movement direction. Not inputting a movement direction will result in a 4 metre backwards dash.
Only usable while on the ground.

entries.name: Towering Barricade
entries.desc:
Creates a tall, slightly curved barricade construct in front of the caster that blocks all damage dealt to it.
Grants 20% [20%] Damage Resist while in the Barricade Placement animation.

Barricade lasts for 20 seconds, and has 500 Construct HP. Barricades have 90% Damage Resist against Non-Boss Combatants, and ?% against Boss Combatants.
Enemies that pass through the barricade rapidly receive ? [?] non-lethal damage every ? seconds.

While within ? meters behind the Towering Barricade:
80% Damage Resist against Splash Damage from Combatants.
Combatants up to ? meters in front of the barricade are taunted.

entries.name: Warlock intrinsic traits
entries.desc:
Warlocks intrinsically possess the following traits over Titans and Hunters:

1.1x Grenade Regeneration Speed.
5% [2.5%] Increased Grenade Ability Damage.

entries.name: Empowering Rift
entries.desc:
Conjures an Empowering Rift beneath the caster for 15 seconds.

Rift grants 20% [15%] increased damage, 260% [104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee, and 230% [92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate in a 5 meter radius.
Kills while in the Rift grant 1.15x Ammo Generation Multiplier. Ammo Generation Multiplier is additive to Ammo Finder Multipliers.

Grants 20% Damage Resist and allows movement at a speed of ?m/s while in the Rift Placement animation.

entries.name: Healing Rift
entries.desc:
Conjures a Healing Rift beneath the caster that continuously restores 40 [35] HP per second in a 5 meter radius for 15 seconds.

While at Full Health | Healing Rift generates 3 Overshield HP per second, up to 15 Overshield HP. Having Void Overshield prevents this from happening.
Overshield can stack with other overshields, such as Turnabout's OS and Class Stat OS. Overshield layers are determined by "First In, First Out".
Healing Rifts cause the users to count as having Overshields for the purpose of perk interactions.

Grants 20% Damage Resist and allows movement at a speed of ?m/s while in the Rift Placement animation.

entries.name: Phoenix Dive
entries.desc:
Dive that applies Cure x2 to the user and their allies within 9 meters.

While Heat Rises is active:
Applies Restoration x2 for 3+1.5 seconds upon diving.
Deals 100 damage and x40+20 Scorch to enemies within 5 metres upon landing.

entries.name: Ace of Spades
entries.desc:
Kinetic Adaptive Hand Cannon

Radar remains active while ADS.

Enhanced Firefly deals a maximum of 436 [80?] Damage, down to a minimum of 20% [?] Damage over 7.5 meters, with Damage Falloff Start at 3.75m.

Upon finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a kill:
Grants x6 Memento Mori bullets.
Firing consumes a stack of Memento Mori per shot, granting 68% [29%] increased damage and 15% Decreased Damage Falloff Distance.
Memento Mori is removed on stow. Reload Trigger persists through stow.

↑Funeral Pyre:
50% Increased Firefly Damage while Memento Mori is active.

egExotic.name: Ace of Spades
egExotic.summary: standard 140 HC with buffed Firefly and 68% damage for 6 shots on kill-reload

entries.desc:
Stasis Adaptive Trace Rifle
Intrinsically has a 1.3x PVE Bonus over Legendary Trace Rifles.

Kills trigger a Stasis Burst, inflicting x100 [x50] Slow Stacks to enemies within 10 meters.
Stasis Kills refill 10 Ammo.

Immediately drains 20% Super Energy, then constantly drains 4% Super Energy per Second.

egExotic.name: Ager's Scepter
egExotic.summary: instant splash freeze + refill on kill, has super drain mode that does decent DPS
egExotic.usage: decent add clear but not anything worth exotic slot, only use is best low power add clear trace

entries.name: Alethonym
entries.desc:
Stasis Micro-Missile Grenade Launcher Rifle
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses. Deals 40% increased damage against Rank-and-File Combatants (compared to Exotic Primary's 30%)

Fires Harvester Spikes in a straight line, dealing 43 [39] Impact Damage, and up to 697 [91] Explosive Damage, down to 30% damage over 5 meters.
Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses become impaled on direct hits, being dealt 79 Damage every 0.8 seconds up to 6 times over 4 seconds.
Impaled Enemies trigger the Harvester Spike Explosion on the sixth tick, removing the impaled projectile.
Impale Damage is non-lethal. There is no limit to the amount of simultaneous impales on a single enemy.

Kills create a floating Vestige that home in towards the user. Picking up a Vestige grants Vestigial Alchemy Energy.
Picking up 7 Vestiges totals 50% Vestige Energy. Requires an additional 10 Vestiges (17 Total) to reach 100% Energy.
Impaled Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses spawn a Vestige every time Impale damage ticks, spawning up to 6 Vestiges on a single shot.

Holding [Reload] while Vestigial Alchemy is at least at 50% Energy toggles between Firing Modes.
50%–99% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode | 100% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode -> Heavy Ammo Mode
Ammo-Loaded Shots deplete Vestigial Alchemy Energy, and always explode on hit, meaning they cannot impale Combatants.

Special Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Special Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 50% Vestigial Energy.
Special Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

Heavy Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Heavy Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 100% Vestigial Energy.
Heavy Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the One For All trait.

egExotic.name: Alethonym
egExotic.summary: stackable micro-missile GL that gets ammo creation charges via pickups
egExotic.usage: primary movement tool, slow guaranteed ammo gen, fast grapple option

entries.name: Arbalest
entries.desc:

entries.desc:

Dealing damage charges Blight at a rate of 2% Blight per damage instance, reaching 100% Blight after dealing damage 50 times.
Blight decays at a rate of 3.33% every 1.2 seconds after not firing for 1.3 seconds, fully decaying after 41.1 seconds.
Grants increased Reload Speed based on the amount of Blight Seekers prepared.
Blight charge persists through stow, and decays normally.

On Reload:
Triggers Panic Response, converting all stored Blight into Blighted Seekers, at a rate of 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight, up to a maximum of 6 Seekers.
Always rounds up to the nearest Seeker number. Eg: 1% Blight = 1 Seeker, 52% = 4 Seekers, 84% = 6 Seekers.
Blight Seekers are fired at a rate of 450RPM Hipfire | 720RPM ADS, overwriting regular shots.
Panic Response lasts for 7 seconds, and persists through stow.

Taken Resolution
Dealing damage to 3 enemies within ? seconds of each grants 50% Blight.
Blighted Seekers deal 173 [6.85 Guardians | 81 Constructs] Damage over 3? meters on hit.
Blight Seekers pierce through enemies, seeking a maximum of 2 additional enemies within 10? meters of each.
Seekers can re-target enemies already hit by them.

Taken Ambition
Scoring 12 damage instances within 1 seconds of each on a single enemy or construct grants 22% Blight. Due to rounding, dealing damage 24 times is enough to grant 6 Seekers.
Blighted Seekers explode on impact, dealing 45 [9?] Impact Damage and 542 [21?] Explosive Damage over 0.25? meters.

Grants the option to slot-in High-Impact Reserves, Hatchling, One For All, or Target Lock trait equivalents.

egExotic.name: Monte Carlo
egExotic.summary: 2% melee on hit, 25% chance to give full melee on kill, 65% Swashbuckler-type damage perk, has buffable special reload bayonet
egExotic.usage: tempo too slow compared to other melee synergy exotics

entries.name: Necrochasm
entries.desc:
Kinetic Rapid-Fire Auto Rifle
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

On Precision Kill, or upon scoring a Cursed Thrall Explosion Kill, or upon killing a Corrupted Enemy:
+70? Reload Speed and 0.9?x Reload Duration Multiplier for ? seconds.
Triggers a Cursed Thrall Explosion, dealing up to 630 [130?] Arc Damage, down to 10% damage and inflicting Corruption over a 8 meter radius.
Cursed Thrall Explosion Kills refill Magazine.
Corruption deals 18 [0.4?] Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds for 3.5 [2] seconds.
Cursed Thrall Explosion and Corruption Damage scale with Combatant Rank Multipliers.
Fun Fact: Cursed Thrall (Hive Combatants) deal 250 damage against Combatants.

Upon finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Precision Kill, or upon scoring a Cursed Thrall Explosion Kill:
0.8x Fire Recovery Delay Multiplier, +6? Stability, +10-15? Aim Assist for 7 seconds.

↑One for Thrall:
Damaging 3 enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage, +? Range, and +? Aim Assist for 10 seconds.
One For Thrall can be reactivated by damaging 3 enemies again, and persists through stow.

egExotic.name: Necrochasm
egExotic.summary: chainable cursed thrall explosion on crit kill, fire rate buff on crit kill-reload or splash kill, refreshable OFA variant
egExotic.usage: surprisingly high QoL kinetic add clear option, less artifact synergy but still pretty strong

entries.name: New Land Beyond
entries.desc:
Kinetic Bolt-Action Sniper Rifle.

Fires a bullet that deals 970 [155] Kinetic Damage with a 2.75x Precision Multiplier, followed by a rechamber that scales based on the Reload Speed.
Rechamber animation can be skipped following the "clink" noise by sprinting, allowing for considerably faster fire rate.

Rechamber Speed:
Base Rechamber Speed allows firing every 1.834 seconds.
Bullseye Bolster allows firing every 1.49 seconds.
100 Reload Speed allows firing every 1.35 seconds.
 100 Reload Speed + Bullseye Bolster allows firing every 1.275 seconds.
100 Reload Speed + Rechamber Cancelling + Bullseye Bolster allows firing every ~1.05 seconds.

Upon scoring a Precision Hit:
Grants a stack of The Master, up to a maximum of 100 until death.
+? Stability, +? Handling, +40 Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist, and 0.95x Fire Recovery Delay? for 3 seconds or until firing and not scoring a Precision Hit.

The Master:
Grants increased Precision Damage, up to 70% at 20 stacks.
15.7% | 22.2% | 27% | 31.3% | 35% x5
38.4% | 41.4% | 44.3% | 47% | 49.5% x10
51.9% | 54.2% | 56.5% | 58.6% | 60.7% x15
62.64% | 64.56% | 66.42% | 68.23% | 70% x20
Renames to The Grandmaster upon reaching 20 stacks, slowly increasing up to 73% over 100 stacks. Shots visually explode while at 20+ stacks.
 Transforms into THE GRANDERMASTER at 100 stacks. Transforms into The Chief Master at 999 stacks.

↑Top Tier Mastery: While at >20 Master stacks:
Magazine is constantly refilled, effectively removing reloading requirements.
Bullseye Bolster duration is increased to ? seconds.

egExotic.name: New Land Beyond
egExotic.summary: bolt-action sniper that scales to +73% damage on crits, fire rate scales with reload buffs, infinitely fires beyond 20 stacks
egExotic.usage: legendary version exists in energy slot, excellent ammo economy but struggles to find niche

entries.name: New Malpais
entries.desc:
Strand Special Ammo Micro-Missile Pulse Rifle
Hold [Reload] to manually detonate all embedded projectiles.

Fires a 3-round burst of sticky projectiles that embed themselves to enemies and surfaces they hit, each dealing 271 [2] Impact Damage.
Projectiles detonate upon holding [Reload] or after being embed for 6 seconds, detonating for up to 321 [60] Explosive Damage over 6 meters.

Manually triggering the detonation of 6 embedded projectiles on a single enemy inflicts Suspension.

↑Unraveling Blast: Explosive Damage from Enemy-Embedded Projectiles now inflicts Unravel.
entries.frame: Strand Special Ammo Micro-Missile Pulse Rifle

egExotic.name: New Malpais
egExotic.summary: 3 shot sticky burst, embedded stickies unravel and explode via special reload, suspend blast on 2 burst detonation
egExotic.usage: stickies are useful for activating on-hit objectives from range or simultaneously

entries.name: No Time to Explain
entries.desc:
Kinetic High-Impact Pulse Rifle.

Precision Hits and Hits against enemies affected by Stasis grant a stack of Rewind Again and refill 1 Ammo.
Reaching 10 stacks summons a Time-slip Portal for 9 seconds. Precision Hits extend its duration by 1 second.
Rewind Again stacks persist through stow.

Time-slip Portal:
 Shoots a burst of 3 bullets every 1.25 seconds towards enemies within 50 metres that are near the reticle.
Each bullet deals 49 [10.2] damage, has no damage falloff, inherits No Time To Explain's Shield-Piercing, and scales with Combatant Rank Multipliers.
Time-slip Portal is removed on stow.

↑Blast from the Side:
Timebuddy Portal burst delay is decreased to 0.85 seconds.

egExotic.name: No Time to Explain
egExotic.summary: 10 crits or stasis-debuffed hits spawn buddy turret
egExotic.usage: terrible damage profile and dated add clear effect

entries.name: Osteo Striga
entries.desc:
Craftable Kinetic Precision Submachine Gun
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

Fires slow, seeking projectiles that deal ~10.8% increased damage over a Precision Submachine Gun's.

Scoring 14 Hits or 7 Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each or scoring a kill triggers a Potent Corruption Burst centered on the enemy, corrupting enemies within 5 metres.

Potent Corruption mechanics are identical to Necrotic Grips. Incurs a 2-second cooldown between corruption bursts on death.
Osteo Striga's Potent Corruption is affected by Buffs, Debuffs, Exotic Primary Rank-and-File Bonus, and the Kinetic Damage Bonus.
Reinflicting Potent Corruption resets the stacking damage.

↑Osteo Striga Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Stability and +30 Reload Speed.
 Corruption Kills refill 100% of Magazine, and can overflow up to 300% Increased Magazine Capacity.
Incurs a 0.5 seconds cooldown between Ammo Overflows.

egExotic.name: Osteo Striga
egExotic.summary: tracking projectiles, 7 crits or 14 hits within 3s or kill makes poison burst, poison kills refill mag and can overflow to 4x mag
egExotic.usage: decent add clear option but nothing special, lacks artifact synergy too

entries.name: Outbreak Perfected
entries.desc:
Craftable Kinetic Lightweight Pulse Rifle
Uses Auto Rifle Recoil Animations.

Scoring 12 Hits within 1? seconds of each spawns 2–3 nanites.
Precision Kills spawn 9 nanites.

Nanites:
Tracking Projectiles that chase after enemies within ? meters, dealing 77 [13] damage on impact and embedding themselves for 9 seconds.
Nanites that haven't embedded on an enemy begin disappearing after 3 seconds. Embedding additional nanites refreshes the duration to 9 seconds.

Outbreak Perfected deals increased damage to enemies with nanites based on the amount of nanites.
x1 = 30% [15%] | x2 = 60% [30%] | x3 = 90% [45%] | x4 = 120% [75%] | x5 = 150% [?%] | x100 = 300% [?%]
Each Nanite after the fifth increases the damage buff by 2.1%, up to 300% [?%] at x100 Nanites.
Nanited Enemies are highlighted on Outbreak's scope. Does not work for all ornaments.

↑Disease Vector:
25% Increased Nanite impact damage.
Nanited Enemies release 4 Disease Vector Nanites on death.
Disease Vector Nanites deal 13 [?] damage.

egExotic.name: Outbreak Perfected
egExotic.summary: 12 crits spawn nanites, eventually scaling to 4x damage, nanite swarm spawned on kills
egExotic.usage: very slow exotic effect, awful for damage, super generation is nuked

entries.name: Praxic Blade
entries.desc:
Special Ammo Shield-Piercing Lightsaber Sword
Modifiable Tangs, Grips, Traits, Mods, and Catalysts.
Deals 50% increased damage towards Combatant Shields, and 200% increased damage towards Barrier Shields.
Defensive Form for base damage values against Elites, as it has no damage bonuses.

[Light Attack] performs a Melee Combo, with each hit dealing 479 [256] Kinetic Damage. Melee Attacks can discharge Bolt Charge.
Using [Heavy Attack] after performing 3 [Light Attacks] executes a Cormorant Combo.
Cormorant Combo deals 689 [368] Kinetic Damage, followed by 3 damage instances of 417 [220] Kinetic Damage each, totalling 1940 [☠️] damage.

[Heavy Attack Press] performs a Ranged Attack, throwing the blade forward up to 50 meters away, homing towards up to 3 enemies before returning.
Deals 945 [174] Kinetic Damage per hit. Damage is reduced by 80% when returning. Attacking recalls the blade.

[Heavy Attack Hold] throws the blade on a straight path forward, dealing 100% increased damage. [Heavy Attack Release] to recall the blade.

[Blocking] grants 100% [~46%] Damage Resist against all damage in a ?° cone.
Blocking a hit retaliates by reflecting a Crystal-Color Matching Bolt that deals 255 [50] Kinetic Damage towards the reticle.

-------------

Balanced Form | Scoring 3 Melee Attack Kills within 5 seconds of each grants +1 Ammo, restores 65 HP, and begins Health Regeneration.
Deals 10% increased damage against Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants. Technically 11.2% due to impact stat shift.

Defensive Form | Blocking an attack within 1 seconds of beginning to block grants 20% increased damage for 2 seconds.
Blocking ? attacks within ? seconds of each attack grants +1 Ammo, up to once per second.

Offensive Form | Scoring 3 damage instances within ? seconds of each grants +1 Ammo.
Deals 15% increased damage against Bosses and Vehicles.

egExotic.name: Praxic Blade
egExotic.summary: extremely versatile multi-mode sword with insane ammo economy and variable catalysts
egExotic.usage: Hyperblade used for movement, insanely consistent neutral option despite not being very optimal

entries.name: Praxic Blade 2:
entries.desc:
Cores grant an Elemental Effect based on the element of the equipped Super Ability:
Solar Effects that are initially applied by Praxic Blade deal 5% increased damage and their damage can be increased by Weapon Buffs.

Impact Core [On Melee Damage Instance] = x1 Bolt Charge | x25?+10? Scorch | Weaken for 6s | x40? Slow for ?s | Sever for 10s
Refraction Core [On Reflect Bolt Hit] =  x1 Bolt Charge | x10+7? Scorch | Weaken for ?s | x20 Slow for ?s | Sever for ?s
Gyro Core [On Ranged Hit] = x1 Bolt Charge | x35?+15? Scorch | Weaken for 6s | x50? Slow for ?s | Sever for ?s

↑Slottable Catalysts:
↑Echoing Blade = Thrown Blade can home towards up to 5 enemies, up from 3.
↑Upper Hand = 30% Increased Ranged/Reflect Damage against enemies that are at least 3? meters beneath the user. Does NOT require being grounded.
↑Hyperblade = Reflecting grants Amplified for 15 seconds and 100?% Increased Lunge Distance for the next Melee Swing. Hyperblade is removed on stow.
↑Energy Conduit = Catching the thrown blade begins Health Regeneration and restores ? Health per Ranged Hit scored in the throw, up to ? HP for 10 hits.

entries.name: Quicksilver Storm
entries.desc:
Kinetic ↑Strand Rapid-Fire Auto Rifle
 Displayed Damage Numbers are for the Strand Version.

Hits progress a Tracking Micro-Missile counter which, upon reaching 100% Progress, which will overwrite a regular bullet when firing.
Precision Hits = ~10.25% | Bodyshots = ~7.7% | Hit Counter persists through stow, and is removed on reload.

Tracking Micro-Missile aggressively tracks enemies, dealing 5 [2.7] Impact Damage, and up to 155 [20 Guardians | 80 Constructs] Explosive damage on impact.
Tracking Missile Hits grant a stack of Grenades Prepped for Grenade Launcher Mode, up to 3 Grenades Prepped.
Grenade Prepped stacks and hit counter persist through stow. Missile cannot travel further than 50 metres.

Grenade Launcher Mode:
Hold [Reload] to swap into Grenade Launcher Mode once a Grenade Prepped stack is gained. Firing Mode persist through stow.
Firing consumes a stack to fire a Grenade that deals 30 [14 Guardians | 81 Constructs] Impact Damage.
Grenade Explosion deals up to 1,278 [120 Guardians | 960 Constructs] Explosive Damage, down to 30% Damage over 5 metres.
Grenade deals no self-damage. Automatically queues up a reload to load the next grenade after firing. If out of grenades, it will instead perform a regular reload.

↑Nano-entanglement:
Converts the Damage Type to Strand. No longer receives Kinetic Damage Bonus.
Grenade Launcher Mode Kills create a Tangle.

egExotic.name: Quicksilver Storm
egExotic.summary: Nanotech Tracer Missiles version, landing hits eventually loads special reload grenade that makes tangle on kill
egExotic.usage: on-hit stacking effect is way too slow for current exotic weapon field

entries.name: Rat King
entries.desc:
Kinetic Rapid-Fire Sidearm

Upon finishing a reload within 3 seconds of a kill:
Grants Invisibility for 5.8 seconds.

Grants a stack of Rat Pack per ally with a readied Rat King within 20 metres, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Rat Pack decreases Fire Recovery Delay and increases Magazine Size.

Rat Pack:
- | 0.87x | 0.8x | 0.7x | 0.6x Fire Recovery Delay
- | +2 | +4 | +6 | +9 Magazine Size

↑Infestation:
Passively grants +20 Aim Assist and +20 Recoil Direction.
Finishing a reload within 6 seconds of a kill begins Health Regeneration and restores ~2 HP.

egExotic.name: Rat King
egExotic.summary: regen start and invis for 5.8s on kill-reload, massive fire rate and mag increase scaling with nearby allies using Rat King
egExotic.usage: subclass-independent guaranteed invisibility method, otherwise pretty bad

entries.name: Revision Zero
entries.desc:
Craftable Kinetic Pulse Rifle
Selectable Origin Traits, between Heavy Burst Frames and Aggressive Burst Frames.

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a stack of Targeting Data, up to 4 stacks after 48 Precision Hits.

Hunter's Trace:
Hold [Reload] while at least one stack of Targeting Data is loaded to swap into Hunter's Trace. Ammo loaded is equal to the amount of Targeting Data stacks acquired.
Replaces the 18 Zoom Scope with a 50 Zoom Scope. Fires with perfect accuracy, and has a Red Sniper Rifle Glint.
Fires High-Damage Hunter's Trace Rounds that deal 564 [158] Damage with a 3.25x Precision Multiplier at 72RPM and inherit the Shield-Piercing effect.
Scoring a Hunter's Trace hit triggers a Kinetic Shockwave that deals up to 322 [20] Damage, down to 0% damage, and exhausts for 5 seconds over 6 meters.
Hunter's Trace persists through stow and can only be deactivated by fully emptying the magazine or dying.
Exhaust reduces Combatant Damage Output by 25%.

↑Selectable Retrofit:
Grants the option to slot-in Feeding Frenzy, Fourth Time's The Charm, Outlaw, or Under Pressure trait equivalents. Fourth Time's The Charm allows firing up to 6 Sniper Shots.

egExotic.name: Revision Zero
egExotic.summary: meter filled on crits, consumed to give sniper shots that spawn kinetic shockwaves, has FTTC
egExotic.usage: strong single target, Hunter's Trace shots do a lot, but doesn't find a niche

entries.name: Sturm
entries.desc:
Kinetic Aggressive Hand Cannon

Kills refill Energy Weapons Magazine and grant +1 Increased Together Forever Base Magazine Capacity, up to a maximum of 100% Increased Base Magazine Capacity.

 Together Forever Weapons Kills load an Overcharged Round.
Scoring multiple Together Forever Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each loads additional rounds, up to a maximum of 25 loaded rounds.
2 Rapid Kills = +2 Overcharged Rounds per kill | 3+ Rapid Kills and onwards = +3 Overcharged Rounds per kill.
Overcharged Rounds persist through stow and are lost on death.

Firing consumes an Overcharged Round to deal increased damage.
Rank-and-File and Elites = 300% increased damage | Mini-bosses and Champions = 280% | Bosses = 260% | Guardians = 75%

↑Helping Hands: Passively grants +20 Range and +40 Handling.
Overcharged Round Kills grants 2 stacks of Definitely-Not-Shot Swap, up to a maximum of 6 stacks.

Upon stowing Sturm or a Together Forever Weapon:
Consumes a stack of Helping Hands, granting 0.5x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier.

egExotic.name: Sturm
egExotic.summary: energy weapon refill on kill, Together Forever kills load overcharged rounds (more on multikills) that do up to 4x damage
egExotic.usage: very unremarkable exotic effect, purely single target

entries.name: SUROS Regime
entries.desc:
Kinetic Adaptive Auto Rifle
Selectable Trait between Dual Speed Receiver and Spinning Up.
Hold [Reload] to swap shooting modes.

Kills have a 25% chance to begin Health Regeneration and restore 20HP.

Dual Speed Receiver turns the weapon into a High-Impact Auto Rifle Frame with +3 Zoom and +30 Range while ADS.
Scoring kills while Dual Speed Receiver ADS is active grants 1.?x Heavy Ammo Progress Multiplier.

Spinning Up grants 0.83x to 0.67x Fire Recovery Delay while holding down the trigger.
RPM increases every 12 bullets while holding down the trigger. Releasing the trigger resets the buff.
Scoring kills while Spinning Up is active grants 1.?x Special Ammo Progress Multiplier.

As magazine progressively decreases below 50%, down to 0%:
5% to 10% increased damage.

↑SUROS Ascendance:
Passively grants +50 Recoil Direction.
Kills have a 50% chance to restore health.

egExotic.name: SUROS Regime
egExotic.summary: either stable fire rate + extra heavy progress or ramping fire rate + extra special progress, has modified HIR and 50% chance to heal on kill
egExotic.usage: purely single target, ammo effect is not nearly good enough

entries.name: Sweet Business
entries.desc:
Kinetic Minigun High-Impact Auto Rifle

Rapidly shoots bullets that deal 41 [16.45] damage with a 1.51x Precision Multiplier.

On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Refills magazine.

While holding down the trigger:
Spins up the weapon, gradually granting up to 0.4x Fire Recovery Delay and +? Range over 1.38 seconds.
-15% Hipfire Accuracy Cone Size while fully spun up.

Fires an explosive round every 18 shots, dealing 56 [21] damage over 4 meters with no damage falloff.
Explosive Shot requirement is lowered to 8 while fully spun up.

↑Serious Business:
25% Flinch Resistance while fully spun up.

egExotic.name: Sweet Business
egExotic.summary: ramping fire rate and massive mag, occasional explosive round, refill on brick pickup
egExotic.usage: terrible minor DPS even when ramped, nothing else special

entries.name: The Navigator
entries.desc:
Strand Adaptive Trace Rifle

Upon scoring 8 hits within 1 second of each on an ally:
Ally restores 60HP, begins Health Regeneration, and is granted Woven Mail. Wielder is granted Woven Mail and generates 5 Ammo.
If Shields are healed, then Shields will recharge, otherwise only up to Critical Health.

Upon scoring 20 hits within 1 second of each:
Inflicts sever, and grants the wielder Woven Mail.

While Woven Mail is active:
25% [5%] increased damage and +40 Ammo Generation.

↑Gordian Knot. Hold [Reload] to swap into Grapple Tangle Firing Mode.
Grapple Tangle Mode shoots a Grapple Tangle up to 23.5 meters away at the cost of 1 Ammo.
Shows a preview of the Grapple Tangle impact spot while Alternate Fire Mode is active.
Incurs a 30 second cooldown before Alt Fire can be activated upon creating a Grapple Tangle. Must land on the ground for the timer to begin. Stowing swaps back to Trace Rifle Mode.

egExotic.name: The Navigator
egExotic.summary: 8 ally hits gives 60 HP, regen, and Woven Mail to both parties, Woven Mail + sever on 20 enemy hits, grapple tangle special reload
egExotic.usage: only relevant for Woven Mail applications (limited beyond contest) and grapple melee bosses (almost none)

entries.name: Thorn
entries.desc:
Kinetic Adaptive Hand Cannon
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

Direct hits corrupt, dealing 30 [0.4] Kinetic Damage after a 0.3 seconds delay, every 0.5 seconds 4 times, dealing up to 120 [1.6] Kinetic Damage over 2 seconds.
Corruption can be stacked.

Kills create a floating Remnant that home in towards the user while within 15 metres.
Remnants refill 4 Ammo, overflowing up to 40 Ammo, and grant Soul Devourer for an initial duration of 7 seconds on pickup.
Soul Devourer increases Corruption Damage by 200% [1750?%].
Picking up additional Remnants extend the duration of Soul Devourer by +7 seconds, up to 11 seconds.
Soul Devourer persists through stow.

↑Refined Soul: Passively grants +15 Range, +5 Stability, and +5 Airborne Effectiveness.
Scoring a kill or picking up a Remnant grant Refined Soul for 7 seconds.
Refined Soul grants additional +10? Range, +15? Handling, and +50 Mobility.
Picking up additional Remnants, or scoring additional kills extend the duration of Refined Soul by +7 seconds, up to 11 seconds.
Refined Soul remains active while stowed.

egExotic.name: Thorn
egExotic.summary: poison ticks on hit, kills create remnant that refills 4 ammo (overflow up to 40) and buffs poison damage by 3x for 7s
egExotic.usage: falls significantly behind other kinetic primaries in lethality and splash application

entries.name: Touch of Malice
entries.desc:
Kinetic Rapid-Fire Scout Rifle
Hold [Reload] to trigger Blight Launcher once charged. Swap Speed is tied to Reload Speed.
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

Scoring Precision Hits grants a stack of Charged With Blight, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Charged With Blight grants up to +? Stability and +? Reload Speed at 10 stacks.
Blight Launcher Mode can be toggled once at 10 stacks. Does not refill the magazine.

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress through Weapon Kills within 5 seconds of each:
 Rank-And-File = 50% | Elites/Minibosses/Bosses = 100% | Guardians = 66.7%.
Begins Health Regeneration and restores 105 HP.

While Magazine = 1:
132% [30%] increased damage, drains 7 HP per shot, and refunds itself. Health Drain is not lethal.
Blight Launcher's Damage benefits from the Final Round's Damage Increase. Health Drain is affected by Damage Resist.

Blight Launcher:
Shoots a slow moving Blight that deals 220 [113] Arc Damage on direct impact, and has a damaging field that deals 3 damage, blinds and corrupts enemies.
Corrupt deals 27 [0.375?] Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds for 3.5 [2] seconds a total of 7 [4] times.
Enemies hit by the Blight receive 50% increased damage taken from Weapons of Sorrow for 5 seconds.
Entering Blight Launcher Mode begins Health Regeneration and restores 105 HP.

↑Touch of Mercy:
Grants the Precision Instrument trait.
Precision Instrument lasts long enough to trigger Blight Launcher, shoot it, and then keep firing normally.

egExotic.name: Touch of Malice
egExotic.summary: special reload blight that buffs Weapons of Sorrow by 50%, +132% infinite final round damage, has Precision Instrument
egExotic.usage: significantly behind even non-Moebius Hierarchy, explicitly single target, self-damage not ideal

entries.name: Traveler's Chosen
entries.desc:
Kinetic Adaptive Sidearm

Kills grants a stack of Gathering Light, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Gathering Light grants +15 Handling, +15 Reload Speed, and +2 Aim Assist per stack.
Gathering Light stacks persist through stow.

Holding [Reload] will trigger a special reload animation, consuming all stacks of Gathering Light to provide Ability Energy.
Grants 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy per Gathering Light stack

↑Catalyst:
Passively grants +2 Magazine Size (15 -> 17), the Osmosis trait, and the Surplus trait.

egExotic.name: Traveler's Chosen
egExotic.summary: 10 stack kill counter, consume to get 10% of every ability per stack, has Osmosis
egExotic.usage: only niche is regenerating abilities post-swap, but still requires 10 kills

entries.name: Verglas Curve
entries.desc:
Stasis Lightweight Bow
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Kills grant a stack of Hail Barrage, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Hipfiring releases every stored Hail Barage Arrow in a volley, spread out evenly.
Hail Barrage stacks persist through stow.

Hail Barrage Arrows create a Large Stasis Crystal on impact, and inflict x100 [x60 for 1+1 seconds] Slow on direct hit.

Deals 50% increased damage against Frozen Enemies and Stasis Crystals. Stacks multiplicatively with Whisper of Rending and Frozen Enemy Multipliers.

↑Shiver Quiver:
0.65x Draw Time Multiplier for 5 seconds upon inflicting freeze or slow.

egExotic.name: Verglas Curve
egExotic.summary: 5 stack kill counter that makes freezing crystal shots on hipfire, size scales with stacks, +50% damage to frozen enemies
egExotic.usage: used for making hiding spot crystals in challenges and line spots in speedruns, otherwise very slow neutral

entries.name: Vigilance Wing
entries.desc:
Kinetic 5-Round Burst High-Impact Pulse Rifle

Shoots a burst of 5 bullets, each dealing 41 [16] damage with a 1.63x Precision Multiplier.
Only weapon in the game with deterministic recoil.

On Ally Death within 24 metres:
+20 Mobility, increases Sprint Speed from 8 m/s to 8.5m/s, and increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters for 6 seconds.
Begins Health Regeneration.

While Last Guardian Standing or Solo:
+100 Health Stat, +X Handling, and +30? Reload Speed.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the Ensemble trait.

egExotic.name: Vigilance Wing
egExotic.summary: 5 shot burst, PvP stat buffs on ally death or solo
egExotic.usage: little to no PvE effect

entries.name: Wicked Implement
entries.desc:
Stasis Rapid-Fire Scout Rifle

Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 4.5 seconds of each grants Creeping Attrition for 4.5 seconds.
Additional Precision Hits refresh the duration of Creeping Attrition.
Creeping Attrition is removed on stow.

While Creeping Attrition is active:
Precision Hits inflict x40 [x20] Slow for 4+4 [4+2] seconds.

Scoring a Precision Kill or shattering a Stasis Crystal creates a Small Stasis Shard that returns to the wielder.
 Incurs a 2 second cooldown between spawning shards.

Collecting a Stasis Shard or destroying a Stasis Crystals refills the Magazine.

↑Hadopelagic Tribute:
Stasis Shards additionally overflow +5 Ammo on pickup, overflowing up to 100% Increased Magazine Capacity, and the Headstone trait.

egExotic.name: Wicked Implement
egExotic.summary: 4.5s slowing crit buff after 4 crits, stasis shard on crit kill or crystal shatter, overflow on shard pickup or crystal break, has Headstone
egExotic.usage: gameplay loop too slow for modern sandbox, better legendary stasis weapons exist

entries.name: Wish-Ender
entries.desc:
Kinetic Lightweight Combat Bow

[ADS] while fully-drawn grants Truesight, displaying enemy silhouettes through walls up to 64 metres away.
Truesight lasts until no longer ADS, or after 3 seconds of being active. Must fully redraw to reactivate the perk.

Arrows deal a total of 1,164 [159] damage split into 3 [2] different damage instances.
The initial arrow impact deals up to 276 [129] damage with a 1.79x Precision Multiplier.
The two [one] instances from Broadhead deal up to 444 [28.75] damage and are not affected by Precision Hits.
Draw Strength affects the damage of all damage instances.

25% Increased damage against Combatants stuck by Witherhoard's Blight.
10% Increased damage against Taken Combatants.

↑Catalyst: Grants the One For All trait.

egExotic.name: Wish-Ender
egExotic.summary: overpenetrating 3 instance shots, Truesight on ADS, +25% against Witherhoarded enemies, +10% to Taken enemies, has One for All
egExotic.usage: slow draw time on an already low uptime archetype, damage isn't special and no splash effect

entries.name: Wish-Keeper
entries.desc:
Craftable Strand Precision Bow

Precision Hits and Kills charge up Snareweaver Arrows. Snareweaver requires 6 charges to be activated.
Precision Hits = 1 | Rank-and-File = 1 | Elite+ = 2 | Guardian = 3
When fully charged, hipfire to shoot a Snareweaver Arrow.

Snareweaver Arrow:
Hitting an enemy directly releases a snare underneath them and inflicts suspend.
Creates a snare with 6 linked traps in a ⏏ shape on impact. Traps last 15 seconds and have 10 HP.
Enemies that come into contact with the linked traps are dealt 341 [5] damage and become suspended.
Suspending 2 enemies breaks a beam. A snare can suspend up to 6 enemies.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between repeated suspensions on a single enemy.

Deals 50% [20%] increased damage against Suspended enemies.

+100 Reload Speed and 0.7x Draw Time Multiplier for ? seconds.

Hatchling trait or the Vorpal Weapon trait.

entries.desc:

Fires projectiles that detonate upon impacting the floor, dealing up to 172 [51] damage over 6 meters, down to 0% damage, and creating blighted ground on impact.

 Enemies take 86 [40] damage every 0.3 seconds while standing over blighted ground.

Direct hits against Blighted Enemy increases the impact damage to 773 [?] damage.
Blighted Enemies drop a Witherhoard projectile underneath them on death.

Malfeasance and Wish-Ender deal 25% increased damage against Blighted Enemies.

entries.desc:
Multi-Element Aggressive Sniper Rifle
[Reload] switches between the Arc, Solar, and Void Elements.

Guardians in their Super Ability count as having an Elemental Shield that matches the element of their Super.

 Ionic Return:
Consumes a stack upon firing.
15% increased damage and 19% increased Precision Damage.
37% total increased Precision damage over base.

entries.name: Buried Bloodline

Void Rocket-Assisted Frame Sidearm

Each bolt restores 11 HP upon scoring a hit.

Hits inflict Weaken for 5 [?] seconds.
+? Reload Speed and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier.

entries.name: Centrifuse
entries.desc:
Arc Precision Auto Rifle

Refills 10% Ammo every 0.34 seconds while sprinting.

Sprinting, sliding, and shooting builds up charge, granting up to +? Range and +? Reload Speed.
Shooting = +20%/s after firing 3 rounds automatically | Sliding = +10% Charge per slide.
Sprinting = +20% Charge/s after a 0.25 second delay. Movement Speed must be above ~6m/s to build up charge.
Charge decays at a rate of -33% per second after not doing any of those actions for 1.1 seconds. Manual Reloads instantly empty the charge.

Kills while at ≥40% Charge cause the enemy to explode, dealing up to 95 [76] Damage, down to 30% damage, and blind enemies for 10 seconds in a 7 meter radius.
Explosions triggered while at 100% Charge deal 189 [?] Damage, down to 40% damage, and blind enemies for 10 seconds in a 8 meter radius.

Explosion deals up to 239 [?] Void Damage, down to 0% damage over 7.5 meters.

Grants x1 Bolt Charge.

entries.desc:
Arc Adaptive Trace Rifle

Steadily grants up to 80% increased damage as Energy is accumulated.
All energy is removed over 0.2 seconds after not generating energy for 1.05 seconds.

Grants 40% Energy/s for 1 second.

Slowly grants 50% Energy over 0.5 seconds.

+100 Stability and +100 Reload Speed.

entries.name: Collective Obligation

Scoring a hit against an enemy affected by Void Debuffs, or being afflicted with a Void Debuff instantly leeches said debuffs for Void Leech Mode.

Void Leech Mode:
Scoring a hit charges 1.3% Energy (76 hits).  Hits against Void-Debuffed Enemies charge 16.7% Energy (6 hits).
Scoring a kill against an enemy affected by Void Debuffs or being afflicted with a Void Debuff instantly charges Void Leech Mode.
Leeched Void Debuffs persist through stow. Void Leech Mode cannot be charged by self-applied debuffs.

Once charged, hold [Reload] to activate Void Leech for 15 [10] seconds.
Hits will inflict the Void Debuffs that were leeched and grants 20% increased damage.

Receiving Void Buffs refills Magazine. Reactivating Devour through kills also refills the magazine.

Solar Adaptive Sidearm

Kills spawn a Firesprite.
Picking up a Firesprite grants Pyrogenesis Available.

Hits against Suspended Enemies inflict x20+10 Scorch.
Killing a Suspended Enemy triggers an ignition.

Pyrogenesis:
Continuous beam that charges over 0.5 seconds.

Scoring 10 [5] hits within 0.15 seconds of each weakens, increasing damage taken by 15% [15%], and inflicting censured, creating a Precision Cage for 1.25 seconds.

 Enemies that remain in the Precision Field for 3.75 seconds suffer from Penance, receiving 1,735 [520] damage. Damage assumes the weaken, of course.

entries.name: Graviton Spike
entries.desc:

[Reload] to swap between 150RPM Arc Firing Mode and 95RPM Stasis Firing Mode, refilling 3 Ammo.

150RPM Arc Mode:
Fires bullets that deal 141 [42.03] Damage with a 1.85x Precision Multiplier.

Arc Overcharge:
Kills and Precision Hits call down a lightning strike, dealing up to 262, down to 0% damage over 2 meters + 240 over 5 meters = 502 [21 + 21 = 42] Arc Damage.
Each Precision Hit consumes 34% Arc Overcharge. Hitting Stasis Crystals will consume 34% Arc Overcharge to call down a lightning strike on them.

95RPM Stasis Mode:
Fires explosive bullets that deal 185 [43.2] Impact Damage and up to 149 [21.02] Explosive Damage, down to 0% damage over 3 meters with a 1.85x Precision Multiplier.

 Kills and Precision Hits trigger a Stasis Explosion that deals up to 126 [?] Damage, down to 0% damage over 7 meters and create 2 seekers perpendicular to the target.
Seekers spawn a Medium Stasis Crystal rotated 45 degrees away from the enemy after traveling 4 meters, forming a \  / shape.

Triggering the buff has no time limit, and the buff can be refreshed by overcharging both modes in the same order it was activated in.

Charge Levels increase the damage and explosive radius of the next shot fired.

Charged Shots:
x1 | 602 [71] Impact Damage, 631 [41] Explosive Damage, ↑and x20+0 Scorch over 5 meters after 0.5 seconds of charging. Generates 200 Heat upon firing.
x2 | 897 [80] Impact Damage, 688 [49] Explosive Damage, ↑and x40+0 Scorch over 6 meters after 1.2 seconds of charging. Generates 300 Heat upon firing.

entries.name: Hierarchy of Needs
entries.desc:
Solar Lightweight Combat Bow
Unique Damage Profile similar to Precision Bows that uses Lightweight Draw Curves.

Scoring a Precision Hit or a Kill grants a Guidance Ring charge, up to a maximum of 3 charges.
Guidance Ring charges persist through stow.

Guidance Ring:
Spawned by firing a fully-drawn hipfired shot while at x3 Guidance Ring Charges.
 Guidance Ring lasts for 20 seconds and rotates to face its owner. Only 3 Guidance Ring may exist at once across all players. Only 1 Ring per user.
Arrows release explosive seeking projectiles for each Guidance Ring they pass through, up to a maximum of 6 Seekers per shot.
Precision Hits guide the Seekers towards the hit enemy.
Bows require a half-draw minimum to release seekers.

Seeking Projectiles:
Seeker Damage and Quantity varies per source, but they always inflict x15+5 Scorch over 4 meters, and deal a minimum of 20% Damage over 4 meters.
Seeker Damage is counted as Matching Weapon Explosive Damage and will be increased by Weapon Buffs/Surges. Surges must match the Weapon's element!
Seekers can benefit from Volatile Rounds, Unraveling Rounds, and more!

Hierarchy of Needs releases 3 Seekers, each dealing up to 193 [15?] Damage.
Primary Ammo Bows (Including non-listed Exotics) release 2 Seekers, each dealing up to 138 Weapon-Matching Damage. Ticuu's Hipfire releases 3 Seekers.
Trinity Ghoul = 3 x 179 | Wish-Ender = 2 x 167 | Buried Bloodline = 2 x 120 | Heirloom = 2 x 40
Crossbows = 2 x 153 Matching | Leviathan's Breath = 2 x 18

Shadowshot: Moebius Quiver = 3 x 136 per volley | Shadowshot: Deadfall = 6 x 136 per usage
Shadowshot Seekers are counted as Void Super Damage and DON'T scale with Weapon Buffs! They scale with Super Buffs!

↑Panoptic Tessellation: Upon deploying a Guidance Ring or scoring a hit with a seeking projectile:
 -40% Hipfire Accuracy Cone Size, 0.5x Draw Time Multiplier, 100? Reload Speed, and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier for 5 seconds.
 Scoring additional seeker hits or redeploying a Guidance Ring refreshes the buff duration.

Rank-and-File = +1 Ammo every 2 Kills | Elite = +2 Ammo | Miniboss+ = +3 Ammo | Guardians = +? Ammo

Non-Precision Kills, or shattering a Stasis Crystal triggers a Solar Explosion, dealing up to 453 [40] Damage, down to 50% over 7 meters.
Scoring a Precision Kill or shattering a Frozen Enemy triggers an ignition.

Every 10? seconds, the first hit always generates Ammo. Every other hit generates Ammo.

 Telemetry Patterns:

Solar High-Impact Pulse Rifle

Upon scoring a Weapon Kill:
Grants Cure x2, +100 Reload Speed, and 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier for ? seconds.

x2 = +? | ?% | +?% | x3 = +? | ?% | +?% | x4 = +? | ?% | +?% | x5 = +? | ?% | +?% | x6 = +? | ?% | +?%

entries.name: Ruinous Effigy
entries.desc:
Void Adaptive Trace Rifle
Intrinsically has a 1.4x PVE Bonus over Legendary Trace Rifles.

Kills collapse enemies into Transmutation Spheres with 30 Ammo. Spheres can remain on the ground for up to 30 seconds.

Transmutation Spheres are pickupable objects that are able to use Light Attacks, Heavy Attacks, and Guard/Drain. Dropping a Transmutation Sphere immediately despawns it.
Ammo is passively drained at a rate of 1 Ammo Per Second. Attacking or Guarding disables passive drain until the Attack Animation is finished or until no longer Guarding.

Transmutation Spheres:
They are considered Generic Void Weapons, and their damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs, as well as Activity Surges and other generic Void Damage buffs.
They are also able to inflict Volatile through Volatile Rounds.
Spheres will not trigger, nor be affected by any effect related to Melee Abilities, Void Abilities, Trace Rifles, or Weapon Surge Mods.

Light Attacks | Lunges forward, dealing 270 [150] damage, disorienting Combatants and consuming 1 Ammo. Airborne Attacks deal 25% decreased damage. Can attack twice every second.

Heavy Attacks | Slams the Sphere onto the ground, detonating it, dealing 1350 [300 Guardians | 1500 Constructs] damage without falloff and inflicting suppression to enemies within 5? metres.
Damage is unaffected by the Ammo Remaining.

Guarding | Projects a draining field over a ? metre radius, dealing 28 [12] damage and restoring 5 HP per enemy hit every 0.3 seconds.
Grants 80% [50%] Damage Resist and prevents knockback while guarding. Combatants inside the draining field are disoriented.
Ammo Drains at a rate of 1 Ammo every 0.25 seconds. The last remaining 3 Ammo drain at a rate of 1 Ammo every 0.5 seconds until 1 Ammo is left.

Guarding while at 1 Ammo inflicts Transfiguration, dealing increasingly higher self-damage every 0.7 seconds until no longer Guarding or death.
Self-Damage inflicted maxes out at 100 damage per tick and ignores all Damage Resist. Will eventually outright kill after enough time.

↑Deconstruction:
Upon scoring a Transmutation Sphere Kill or upon damaging a Miniboss+ with a Transmutation Sphere:
30% [15%] increased damage for 7 seconds.

 If the submunitions impact a surface, the redirection angle is increased to 360 degrees to enemies within 5 meters.

 15% increased Precision Damage and +? Reload Speed.

entries.name: Symmetry

Arc Rapid-Fire Scout Rifle.

Arc Seeker Mode:
Fires tracking bolts that deal up to 76 [50 Guardians | 25 Constructs] splash damage, down to 0% damage over a 3 meter radius at the cost of 2.6x Fire Recovery Delay.
Tracks to enemies within the aim-assist cone. Deals no self-damage.

Precision Hits and Kills grant a stack of Dynamic Charge, up to a maximum of 15 stacks.

x10 = 4 meter radius | x20 = 7 meter radius

Hits with Arc Seekers grant x2 Bolt Charge and are able to discharge Bolt Charge as long as Dynamic Charge stacks are at least at x1.
Having x10 or higher Dynamic Charge stacks increases Bolt Charge stack gain to x3. Arc Seekers are unaffected by Spark of Frequency's +1 Bolt Charge gains.
Bolt Discharge triggered via Arc Seeker Hits count as Scout Rifle Primary Weapon Damage and are scaleable with both Combatant Scalars and Weapon Buffs.
Storm's Keep (and Well of Radiance's Caster) cause Bolt Discharge to occur twice simultaneously, with one counting as Weapon Damage and the other being a regular discharge.
Stacks multiplicatively with Flashover's 50% increase.
Casting Well of Radiance while behind a Storm's Keep Barricade will trigger 1 Symmetry Discharge and 2 Regular Discharges.

↑Electric Styx:
Dynamic Charge can now stack up to x20.
Passively grants +10 Handling, +10 Reload Speed, and the Eddy Current trait.

egExotic.name: Symmetry
egExotic.summary: hitscan mode builds up charge, alt fire tracking mode gets special scaling Bolt Charge and stack-scaled damage/splash
egExotic.usage: has unique interaction with scalable Bolt Charge, but still insanely slow tempo weapon

entries.name: Tarrabah
entries.desc:
Solar Aggressive Submachine Gun.
Hold [Reload] to quickly activate Ravenous Beast once it is fully charged.

Ravenous Beast Charge:
Damage instances grant 2% [5%] Charge.
Hits against Scorched Enemies grant 3% [6.7%] Power.
Kills grant 10% Charge.
Grants 1% Charge per damage instance taken.
Stowing Tarrabah removes 50% Power. Eg: 70% -> 20%

Ravenous Beast Effects: Magazine gets refilled instantly on activation.
187% [120%] increased Bodyshot Damage, 99% [52.7%] increased Precision Damage, and 0.8x Fire Recovery Delay.
 +100 Handling, +100 Reload Speed, and 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier.
+100 Mobility, and increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters.
50% [15%] Solar Damage Resist.

Ravenous Beast lasts for 8 seconds. Hits increase the buff duration by 0.05 [0.06] seconds.
Hits against Rank-And-File and Elite Combatants increase the duration by 0.3 seconds per hit while the buff timer is ≤3 seconds.

egExotic.name: Tarrabah
egExotic.summary: stores damage instances, then consumes for ~2x damage and fire rate buff with 50% solar resist, has Ambitious Assassin
egExotic.usage: Ravenous Beast buffs provide high uptime and unique niche, high ammo gen too

entries.name: Telesto
entries.desc:
Void Sticky Fusion Rifle

Fires 7 sticky, proximity detonated bolts, each dealing up to 236 [47] Void Damage, down to 12.5% damage over 4 meters each.
Bolts last up to 5 seconds on surfaces, automatically detonate once an enemy is within 3 meters, and cannot be destroyed.

Scoring 3 Void Kills within 4.5 seconds of each triggers Harbinger's Pulse, fully refilling Telesto's Magazine.
Telesto Kills count as 2 Kills.

↑Deeper Pockets:
Passively grants +3 Magazine Size (4 -> 7) and +40 Ammo Generation.

↑Harbinger Seethe:
Hold [Reload] to smack Telesto, priming Harbinger Seethe once Harbinger's Pulse has been triggered 3 times.
The next direct hit creates a portal over the target that releases 22 Telesto bolts over 2.25 seconds.

egExotic.name: Telesto
egExotic.summary: sticky, explosive bolts, 3 void or 2 Telesto kills for refill, special reload that makes void rain portal after 3 refills
egExotic.usage: terrible damage profile, void portal effect requirements are way too steep

entries.name: Tessellation
entries.desc:
Grenade-Matching Adaptive [Weapon|Instrument|Topology] Fusion Rifle
[Reload] transforms the next shot into a Grenade-Matching explosive [Projectile|Shape|Language] at the cost of a Grenade Ability Charge.
Takes 2.3 seconds to transform and refills the magazine.
Can utilize Transcendence Grenades at the cost of a Grenade Ability Charge. Can utilize Song of Flame Wisp Grenades at no cost.
Always uses the element of the current Grenade Ability, regardless of overrides.

Kills grant 20% Grenade Energy and an additional 2.5% Light Transcendent Energy and 2.5% Dark Transcendent Energy.

Explosive [Projectile|Shape|Language]:
Behaves like a rocket, detonating on impact. Deals 250 [57] impact damage, up to 3,552 [166] explosive damage, down to 25% damage at 7 meters.
Kills detonate enemies, triggering a Grenade-Matching Chain Reaction explosion.
Deals 19% increased damage while Transcendence is active.
Explosive shot can be stowed.

↑Property: Unavoidable:
Explosive [Projectile|Shape|Language] impact triggers a delayed detonation after 0.2? seconds.
Enemies within 10 meters of the impact are dealt up to 188 [10] damage and are [afflicts|burdens|cursed| with Elemental Debuffs based on the Grenade Ability Element.

Arc = Blind | Solar = x70+10 Scorch with 5% increased Solar Effect damage | Void = Weaken for 6 [2.5] seconds.
Stasis = x80 Slow for 6+1 [0.5] seconds. | Strand = Sever for 5+2.5

egExotic.name: Tessellation
egExotic.summary: enhanced Demo and Transcendence gains, consumes grenade to create explosive projectile with secondary splash effect
egExotic.usage: best in class instant splash miniboss killer in speedrunning, also decent boss burst

entries.name: The Fourth Horseman
entries.desc:
Arc Automatic 300RPM Shotgun

Fires 12 pellets in full-auto, with each pellet dealing 84 [?] Damage with a 1.1x Precision Multiplier
Each successive shot fired within 0.5 seconds of each has increasingly higher damage and a wider pellet spread.
2nd shot | 17.7% increased damage and +25% Pellet Spread.
3rd shot | 36.5% increased damage and +33% Pellet Spread.
4th shot | 56.5% increased damage and +33% Pellet Spread.
5th shot | 77.5% increased damage and +33% Pellet Spread.

Kills refill Ammo.
RnF Combatants = 1 Ammo | Elites = 0 Ammo?? | Miniboss+ = 5 Ammo
